scenes.text: If every decision waits for you, your business moves at your speed.
Quotes, refunds, schedule changes, supplier questions. They all land on one desk. Yours.
So when you're on a job, or asleep, everything stops.
Watch one day. Twelve decisions come in. And every one of them waits for you.
By five o'clock, three are done. Nine are still waiting. And so are your customers.
Sort them into three piles. Only you. Someone else, with a rule. And nobody at all.
A rule sounds like this. Refunds under fifty dollars, the front desk decides.
Now the small stuff moves without you. And you keep the decisions that need you.
Run the same day again. Eight follow a rule. Three go to your team. One comes to you.
Everything's answered by five. And you handled the one that mattered.
Start this week. Every time someone asks you something, ask yourself. Could a rule answer this?
Follow for one business fix every week.
